title: Web UI: StatusCardStepper component
summary: New StatusCardStepper component + wire into task/phase/feature detail.
description:
Build the chronological status card stepper Web UI component and wire it into task/phase/feature detail pages.

CURRENT STATE:
- task-detail (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx:122-150) renders `Task.statusLog` as a collapsible `<details>` with a vertical text timeline (dot + `from → to` badge + title/description).
- phase-detail (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/phase-detail/route.tsx) and feature-detail show NO status history (phases/features have no statusLog yet — added in P001).
- Status color CSS vars exist: `--color-status-planned`, `--color-status-in-progress`, `--color-status-blocked`, `--color-status-done`, `--color-status-canceled` (used in task-detail status badges).
- `formatDateTime` helper exists (used in task-detail).

WORK:
1. New component `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-card-stepper.tsx`: props `{ statusLog: StatusLogEntry[], currentStatus }`. Renders a horizontal wrap of cards, one per transition in CHRONOLOGICAL order (oldest first). Each card: status icon + `toStatus` label + timestamp (compact, e.g. "Jul 29 14:32"). Card is "filled" (status color background tint + colored border + icon) to represent that state was reached; the FIRST card is the initial state. The CURRENT status card (last entry's toStatus) is fully filled; prior cards are filled-but-muted. Include a leading "planned" card if statusLog is empty or first entry's fromStatus !== "planned". Mobile: cards wrap; keep min-width so they don't crush.
2. task-detail: replace the text timeline `<details>` (route.tsx:122-150) with the stepper (keep it in a collapsible `<details>` titled "Status history" but show the stepper inside).
3. phase-detail + feature-detail: add the stepper using the new `statusLog` from P001 (place it in the header area, below the status badge, or in a "Status history" section).
4. Empty state: if statusLog empty, show a single "planned" card (the current derived status for phases/features, or "planned" for tasks with no transitions).

EDGE CASES: long histories wrap (don't overflow); blocked→in-progress→blocked shows each transition as its own card (full chronological, per user spec); canceled tasks show a canceled card.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: existing status badge in headers; existing task-detail statusLog data (just re-rendered).
